per_finding.id: r4-major optimizer Pi path lists npm:pi-lean-ctx without install consent
per_finding.notes: Enforced at the source: install-pi.py install(allow_package_install=False)/--allow-install, patch-mcp.py RT_LEANCTX_ALLOW_INSTALL=1. Probe REVF-H4b-r5-probe/p.sh (temp HOME/XDG, stub lean-ctx on PATH, curl/npm/cargo stubs failing). Entries: install-recommended-tools-global --host pi, install-leanctx-sb --host pi, stack-optimizer pre:pi, optimize-five-tool-stack --host pi and --host all, receipts.sh rt_apply_host_mcp_batch (RT_HOST=pi, apply/init). Consent: none, leanctx=wire, install, wire+enforce, install+wire, graphify=install+wire with leanctx=wire. Each was run three ways: plain, with RT_LEANCTX_ALLOW_INSTALL=1 RT_PATCH_LEANCTX=1 in the parent env (leak test), and with a committed .silver-bullet.json enabled_by_user=true but no per-user consent. Results in mat0.txt and mat1.txt: npm:pi-lean-ctx is listed ONLY with leanctx install+wire, in all 108 runs. Every SB caller sets the switch explicitly: the optimizer through env with explicit values in both SKIP_RTCM branches, receipts.sh by export 1/0 then unset, the install-pi callers through the CLI flag. So a value in the parent environment does not leak in. Only a direct manual `RT_LEANCTX_ALLOW_INSTALL=1 RT_HOST=pi python3 patch-mcp.py` lists it, which is an explicit operator act. Other patch-mcp callers (repair-graphify, probe-agentmemory) force RT_PATCH_LEANCTX=0; graphify-am-global forces RT_HOST=opencode. Inverse checks in a sandbox copy: forcing allow_package_install=True in install-pi.py fails 2 tests; forcing it in patch-mcp.py fails test_pi_host_success.

Informational. The author's report lists the Cursor-only and mixed files and the tests to re-run after the HC merge. With Cursor removed, recommended-tools.sh Cursor lines 459/461 are moot; in this run they are covered anyway (435/435).

Spot checks: --host auto with a fresh HOME writes nothing ('No host detected ... nothing written', rc 0, no files under HOME). Pi enables only consented tools (matrix). test-pi-consent-wiring 35/0, test-user-consent passes, optimize-five-tool-stack-staged 117/0. The scoped-coverage set of 96 shell test files (consent, allowlist, AGENTS.md, plugin-root, agentmemory .env, hostile config) all pass except the file in issues[0].

issues.problem: Commit 0951fa5 makes patch-mcp.py list npm:pi-lean-ctx only with RT_LEANCTX_ALLOW_INSTALL=1. This default-suite test was not updated. Its run_patch for host pi passes RT_PATCH_LEANCTX=1 without the new switch, so the assertion at line 139 ((.packages | map(select(contains("pi-lean-ctx"))) | length) == 1) now fails and the script exits 1 under set -e. CI stays red, which defeats this package's purpose: it is meant to make CI green.
issues.evidence: bash tests/run-all-tests.sh tests/scripts/test-global-five-tool-instances.sh on H4b HEAD 05922a6 and on HEAD merged with b654bc1: 'TOTAL: 0 passed, 1 failed'. bash -x shows the last command was the jq -e on .pi/agent/settings.json at line 139. The same test at 0951fa5~1 (git archive): rc 0. With RT_LEANCTX_ALLOW_INSTALL=1 exported: rc 0. The scoped coverage run over 102 test files lists it among the failed test files; it is the only real shell failure.
issues.suggested_fix: In run_patch, pass RT_LEANCTX_ALLOW_INSTALL=1 for this full-consent registry test, and add a second Pi run without it that asserts the packages list has no pi-lean-ctx. Then grep tests/ for any other patch-mcp/install-pi callers that expect the package, and run the whole tests/scripts suite once before resubmitting.

issues.problem: Docs and behaviour disagree. CONSENT.md says 'Enabling LeanCTX in Pi needs both wire and install consent'. With leanctx wire only, though, optimize-five-tool-stack (--host pi/all) and receipts.sh still switch leanctx on in the Pi adapter config and write ~/.pi/agent/extensions/pi-lean-ctx/config.json; they only withhold the package. install-recommended-tools-global, install-leanctx-sb and stack-optimizer pre:pi enable nothing. No code is installed, so this is not a consent breach of install, but the entry points are inconsistent. The table row at line 169 also does not mention --allow-install / RT_LEANCTX_ALLOW_INSTALL.
issues.evidence: mat0.txt: 'five L0 P0 leanctx=wire rc=0 packages=[] enabled=["leanctx"]' and 'receipts ... leanctx=wire ... packages=[] enabled=["leanctx"]' vs 'global/leanctx/stackopt ... leanctx=wire ... enabled=none/[]'.
issues.suggested_fix: Either reword the doc (wire enables the adapter route and bridge config; listing the npm package needs install as well) and add the two switches to the table row, or make the optimizer and receipts pass RT_PATCH_LEANCTX=install_flag for host pi.
